description: The plot titled “Finetuning for different r, Gazeta” illustrates how ROUGE-1 varies with the parameter shown on the x-axis for four finetuning configurations (T5/MBart combined with LoRA or AdaLoRA). The x-axis is labeled “log r,” appears to use a linear scale, and spans from 0 to 9 with integer tick marks at regular intervals of 1. The y-axis is labeled “ROUGE-1,” uses a linear scale, and ranges from 0 up to about 36 with major ticks every 5 units. Four solid lines with circular markers are shown: the red line (T5 + LoRA) starts near 23.3 at log r = 0 and stays nearly flat around 24–24.5 across the range, ending near 24.1 at log r = 9; the blue line (MBart + LoRA) starts near 4.8 at log r = 0, rises to about 8.0 at 1, drops to about 2.6 at 2, then increases sharply to about 18.8 at 4 and continues upward to around 24.0 at 8 before ending near 23.3 at 9; the green line (T5 + AdaLoRA) begins around 23.3 at 0 and increases steadily, reaching about 27.0 at 4, about 29.0 at 5, and about 30.1 by 8–9; the orange line (MBart + AdaLoRA) starts near 4.8 at 0, increases through roughly 9.0 (1), 13.2 (2), and 19.5 (3), jumps to about 32.0 at 4, and then remains in the low-to-mid 33 range from 5 to 9, ending around 33.4.
